responsibility: Implements pretty-printing for GCC’s vrange hierarchy. Through vrange_printer visitor methods, it renders unsupported ranges, integer ranges with pair lists and nonzero bitmasks, and floating ranges with decimal/hex endpoints plus NaN-sign annotations, providing the human-readable formatting used by dumps, diagnostics, and debugging of ranger and VRP state.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line printing logic for the declarations in value-range-pretty-print.h. This .cc defines vrange_printer visit methods and helper formatting code for irange/frange details such as bounds, nonzero masks, hexadecimal real rendering, and NaN sign annotations.
